title: Tube laser cutting machines
subtitle: Senfeng T, PLUS, GT, NT, ST and HT tube and profile fiber lasers · Ø0.5″ to 25″ · 20 to 49 ft · 1.5 to 20 kW
cover_line: Senfeng Laser · made in China · sold & serviced in Canada by NovoTech
about_title: Round, square and profile tube cut to length with every hole, cope and notch in one pass
about_text: A tube laser cuts round, square, rectangular and open profiles to length and cuts the holes, copes, slots and notches in them in one pass, straight from the 3D model — no saw, no drill, no notcher, no layout. The T series two-chuck machines cover Ø0.5 to 14″ and 20 to 39 ft with 1.5 to 6 kW; the PLUS series runs to 492 ft/min on small tube and the GPLUS / GT add a 45° bevel head; the NT three-chuck machines cut the last part without a tail; and the ST and HT three- and four-chuck machines carry tube to Ø25″ and 6,600 lb over 29 to 49 ft with 6 to 20 kW sources, for structural steel, towers and trailers. Automatic bundle loaders and unloading conveyors are available for every model.

Senfeng Laser has built fiber laser machines in Jinan, Shandong, since 2004: a 1.8 million ft² campus, its own laser sources, cutting heads and welding guns, around 15,000 machines a year, 20 overseas branches and Senfeng Laser USA with a warehouse and service team. CE, FDA and ETL certified. NovoTech sells, installs and supports the machines in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada — layout for your building, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
